name: Ivory Stag
tagline: The operating system for the independent dental chair.
positioning: Ivory Stag gives solo dentists and small practices one command surface for scheduling, claims, recalls, and supply — no front-desk empire required.

hero.h1: Run your chair like a cathedral, not a call center.
hero.sub: Ivory Stag replaces the four browser tabs, the sticky notes, and the 3pm insurance hold music with a single, ruthless operating layer for your practice.

features.title: Recall That Never Sleeps
features.description: Automated hygiene recalls chase lapsed patients over text, email, and postcard until the chair is filled. You approve the cadence once; the machine works the list forever.

features.title: Claims Without the Purgatory
features.description: Submit, track, and appeal insurance claims from one ledger. Ivory Stag flags rejections before payers do and drafts the appeal for your signature.

features.title: The One-Screen Schedule
features.description: See operatories, hygienists, and no-show risk in a single grid. Drag an opening, fill it from the waitlist, and watch the day rebuild itself.

features.title: Supply Ledger
features.description: Track composite, burs, and gloves against real usage. Reorder points fire automatically so you never scrub in with an empty tray.

features.title: Chairside Charting
features.description: Perio, restorative, and treatment plans captured at the chair on a tablet, synced to billing before the patient reaches the front desk.

features.title: The Numbers You Avoid
features.description: Production per hour, collections ratio, and case acceptance — the metrics your accountant asks about, finally on one honest dashboard.

testimonials.quote: I fired my scheduling software, my recall service, and my claims clearinghouse in one afternoon. Ivory Stag ate all three and my collections are up 22%.
testimonials.name: Dr. Priya Nadkarni

testimonials.quote: As a solo practice I don't have a billing department. Ivory Stag is the billing department. Rejections that used to rot for weeks now clear in days.
testimonials.name: Dr. Marcus Elling

testimonials.quote: The recall engine alone refilled my hygiene column. It found 340 patients I'd quietly given up on and booked a third of them.
testimonials.name: Dr. Hannah Voss
